records.title: First Blooded
records.description: You came through your first real clash and left a mark of your own.

records.title: Road-Worn
records.description: You endured the wear of the road long enough for the journey to become part of your story.

records.title: Keen Eye
records.description: You noticed what others pass by and added a true finding to your record.

records.title: Worked Hands
records.description: You finished honest work with your own hands and made something that held together.

records.title: Closed Deal
records.description: You struck terms, moved goods, and made the exchange count.

records.title: Sworn Task
records.description: You saw a pledged task through to its end and earned the right to be remembered for it.

records.title: Name in Town
records.description: Word of your deeds traveled far enough that people began to speak of you by name.

records.title: First Chronicle
records.description: The ledger has opened and the first life has been set down in record.

records.title: Long Road
records.description: Across more than one life, the road has been walked often enough to leave a pattern.

records.title: Finder's Ledger
records.description: The account has gathered enough true findings to form a respectable field record.

records.title: Market Memory
records.description: Enough bargains have been struck that the ledger now remembers prices better than any stall keeper.

records.title: Maker's Mark
records.description: Repeated craft across several hands has left a recognizable mark in the family record.

records.title: Contract Roll
records.description: Enough sworn work has been completed that the account can point to a reliable record of service.

records.title: Many Banners
records.description: Different bloodlines have now entered the ledger, widening what the account can claim to know.

records.title: Beyond One Shore
records.description: The account is no longer bound to a single continent. Its record now spans a wider world.
